essence: The mantra offers supreme obeisance to Vāsudeva.
The ten-syllabled mantra with hrīṃ and śrīṃ protects in the south.
This sixteen-syllabled mantra ending in svāhā protects in the southwest.
The eighteen-syllabled mantra ending in kāma protects in the northwest.
The twelve-syllabled Viṣṇu protects in the north.
